requested_question: Find the three largest agricultural fields and create a binary mask for them.
actual_run: Full-scene real UniBuild, SegEarth-OV3/SAM 3 and Delineate Anything v2 through the RSAgent field smoke pipeline. VLM transport stubbed to retain eligible proposals; deterministic postprocessing ranked by area. No external endpoint was called.
selection: Three largest semantically eligible candidate polygons by rasterized pixel area, sorted descending, ties by numeric field ID. Eligible includes uncertain proposals.
coordinate_system: pixel grid; PNG has no geographic CRS
caveats: Predictions are not ground truth; uncertain candidates were not reviewed by a VLM. Cropland boundaries can be incorrect, merged or truncated by image edges.
